{{Quote|One must learn from experiences! You act without ever considering the repercussions!|Miarta Sek to Sek'nos Rath|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Miarta Sek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Je'daii Temple Master]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] at the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] reign.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Miarta Sek was born into the [[Sek clan]] who agreed to have her trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Je'daii Order]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], one of nine planets in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] which made up the [[Settled Worlds]]. A trained [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] from the Great Temple of [[Mahara Kesh]], Sek was given the title of [[Je'daii Temple Master]] and oversaw the operations of the Temple of Force Skills, [[Qigong Kesh]]. The maternal grandmother of [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Sek'nos Rath]], Sek and the other Temple Masters formed the [[Je'daii Council]], meeting via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunication]] at the Temple of Balance, [[Akar Kesh]].<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 4]]</ref>
